source.title_on_document: Experimental study on improving the quality of interdisciplinary design: Collaborate with AI psychology experts for design develop process

paper_design_summary: In a within-subjects study built on the Double Diamond design process, 31 designers each completed one traditional design process and one process assisted by a custom AI agent that acts as a psychology expert (built from behavioral activation clinical guidelines, self-help manuals, and interviews with 20 psychological experts). Design and psychology experts rated the 62 design outcomes. The abstract does not say whether the order of the two conditions was randomized.

studies.label: Within-subjects design experiment (traditional vs AI psychology-expert-assisted interdisciplinary design)

assignment.what_was_assigned: Each designer completed both conditions: the traditional design process and the AI-assisted design process. The abstract does not say how the order was set.
assignment.quote: a within-subjects study was conducted based on the Double Diamond Model development process.

arms.description: Designers complete the interdisciplinary design process without the AI agent.

arms.name: AI-assisted design process
arms.description: Designers complete the design process with an AI agent that acts as a psychology expert.

participants.who: Thirty-one designers; the abstract does not say whether they are students or professionals. The same 31 people appear in both arms.
participants.quote: Thirty-one designers completed both the traditional design process and the AI-assisted design process as required. Sixty-two design outcomes were evaluated by design and psychology experts.

eligibility.reason: Abstract only. The study has 31 designers completing both conditions, with 62 evaluated design outcomes; these are 31 people, below the core threshold of 50. The abstract describes a within-subjects study without stating whether condition order was randomized, so criterion 1 remains unclear and design_class remains 'other'. Expert ratings of the produced designs meet criterion 3. Core eligibility is 'no' because the analyzed sample is too small. context_class remains 'none' while assignment is unresolved; a confirmed nonrandom comparison would qualify as observational context under the codebook.

one_line_finding: In a within-subjects study of 31 designers (62 design outcomes rated by design and psychology experts), the abstract reports that the AI psychology-expert-assisted process yielded design outcomes with greater effectiveness, completeness, and applicability than the traditional process; the abstract gives no numerical outcome statistics or effect estimates (PolyU repository abstract).
